facts.fact: A June 2025 public-private partnership between the DRC ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and ICT and Singapore's Trident Digital Tech Holdings makes Trident exclusive provider of the republic's electronic identification (e-KYC) services for DRCPass, over 20 years, per Bankable citing a Ministry of Plan document.

systems.owner: Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and ICT (PPP with Trident)
